svg.title: Sixteen new designs
svg.text: Sixteen ways to make a moment Doddy.
Purposeful graphics. Familiar character. A completely new composition.
A little lean-in. A proper conversation.
One small promise, kept one minute at a time.
A tiny pocket radio, with Doddy on the dial.
Here with you, without taking over.
A small instrument for a little momentum.
Thoughts take shape before they become words.
The island becomes part of Doddy’s gesture.
Speech folds. Focus finds its line.
Less illustration. More confidence. Still Doddy.
A quiet horizon for the thing ahead.
Tie a little knot for later.
Make the big thing a few smaller things.
STRONGEST / Orbit · Thought Pocket · Language Bridge
System precision / Doddy character / action recognition
Static mockups; art-direction preview is separate.
